instruction: Look at hard-16_seed.dxf. In this image, launch AutoCAD 2024 from the desktop shortcut, then open `hard-16_seed.dxf`. Create the hard AutoCAD drawing 'branched pipe skid with flanged ends' using exact model-space coordinates in millimeters. Create or keep these layers exactly as needed: ANNOTATION, CUTOUT, HOLE, JOINT, OUTLINE, PIPE, REFERENCE. Straight geometry may be LINE entities or straight LWPOLYLINE edges; every listed rounded or slot end must be an ARC entity using the listed start/end angles in degrees. Required straight segments: PIPE (0,60)->(60,60); PIPE (60,60)->(100,100); PIPE (100,100)->(180,100); PIPE (180,100)->(225,55); PIPE (225,55)->(290,55); PIPE (100,20)->(100,100); PIPE (180,20)->(180,100). Required circles: OUTLINE center (0,60) radius 18; CUTOUT center (0,60) radius 9; OUTLINE center (290,55) radius 18; CUTOUT center (290,55) radius 9; OUTLINE center (100,20) radius 18; CUTOUT center (100,20) radius 9; OUTLINE center (180,20) radius 18; CUTOUT center (180,20) radius 9; JOINT center (60,60) radius 10; JOINT center (100,100) radius 10; JOINT center (180,100) radius 10; JOINT center (225,55) radius 10; HOLE center (0,78) radius 3.5; HOLE center (0,42) radius 3.5; HOLE center (290,73) radius 3.5; HOLE center (290,37) radius 3.5; HOLE center (100,2) radius 3.5; HOLE center (100,38) radius 3.5; HOLE center (180,2) radius 3.5; HOLE center (180,38) radius 3.5. Required arcs: PIPE center (80,80) radius 28 start 180 end 270; PIPE center (202.5,77.5) radius 32 start 315 end 135. Required text strings: ANNOTATION text ACAD-H16; ANNOTATION text PIPE SKID. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
